subject: MedSecure - Access evidence request (SOC2/SIG)
messages:
From: Jamie Rogers <jamie.rogers@medsecure.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSecure Procurement <procurement@medsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: MedSecure - Access evidence request (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security review queue has a follow-on ask: the SOC2/SIG team needs proof points around how Redwood handles external identity/authorization for our integration. Specifically we need scoped artifacts demonstrating SSO (SAML assertion samples), SCIM delta samples for provisioning, and a short description of RBAC/least-privilege controls you enforce for tenant-scoped roles.

High-level deliverables we want (we can accept redacted data):
- SAML assertion samples (including typical NameID, attributes, audience, and timestamps)
- A SCIM delta export (sample) showing create/update/delete events for a test user
- A short diagram/text describing how you enforce least privilege (service accounts, delegated admin, role scoping)
- Contact for any clarifying questions or a 30-min follow-up call

Target timeline: ideally by EOD Wed 14 Jan so our SOC2 vendor can triage. If that’s not possible, please let us know a firm ETA.

Thanks,
Jamie Rogers
Security Engineer
MedSecure

Attachments: none in this message
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Rogers <jamie.rogers@medsecure.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedSecure - Access evidence request (SOC2/SIG)

Jamie — thanks for the clear list. I can take point on the SAML and SCIM artifacts; I’ll work with Laura (security) to prepare redacted samples and the least-privilege write-up. Grace (CS) is on-copy to help coordinate any account-level context and timing.

Plan:
- I’ll pull SAML assertion examples and a small SCIM delta export from our staging tenant and redact PII.
- Laura will draft a 1-page owners+controls summary covering RBAC, delegated admin, and service account patterns.
- If requested, we can hop on a 30-min call Wed morning to walk the vendor through artifacts.

I’ll aim to deliver the packet by close of day Wednesday (14 Jan). If anything blocks that, I’ll update you by EOD Tue.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedSecure - Access evidence request (SOC2/SIG)

Jamie — looping in Laura (security) — apologies, this is Laura (security lead) — small note on scope and deliverables so expectations are aligned.

We can provide the items requested. A few clarifying points:
1) SAML samples: we will provide three redacted assertion examples (login success, re-auth with MFA flag, and expired-assertion). These will include attribute mappings and timestamps but will have user-identifying fields masked.
2) SCIM delta: we’ll extract a short window (10–20 events) from our staging SCIM webhook log showing create/update/deactivate flows. We will redact any email addresses.
3) RBAC / least privilege: attached is a one-page control summary and an access diagram (see attachments). That will describe: role scoping by tenant, our delegated-admin opt-in model, periodic access reviews, and service-account separation (no user tokens stored in plain text, KMS-wrapped keys).

We expect to upload the packet to a shared folder and also send the three artifact files directly to security@medsecure.com. We will add a short README describing redaction steps.

Questions for you:
- Is the SOC2 vendor comfortable with redacted artifacts (yes/no)?
- Do you need original timestamps in UTC or local time for the SCIM events?

If you confirm redaction is acceptable, we’ll finalize the package and share a Drive link by EOD Wed 14 Jan.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: requested-samples-list.txt, control-summary-20260113.pdf

Subject: Re: MedSecure - Access evidence request (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks Laura / Sergio — redaction is fine for our vendor, confirmed. UTC timestamps preferred for the SCIM delta. Procurement copied me to confirm we have the right contact for SLA language later in the process.

We received your preview list earlier today and the drive link looks good. I attached the DocuSign intake form for our vendor intake (procurement will complete). We’ll review the artifacts after you upload the three files.

One note: our SOC2 assessor requested that the SAML samples include both the SP (your environment) and IdP audience values. If possible, include both in the sample assertion metadata.

We’ll plan a 30-min call Fri 16 Jan 09:00 PST only if we have questions after reviewing the packet — otherwise we’ll triage via email.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Jamie
Security Engineer
MedSecure

Attachments (as separate transfers from MedSecure): docusign-intake-medsecure.pdf (attachment stub), acceptance-confirmation.txt
